summary.text: A lighthouse keeper climbs the tower stairs during a night storm and lights the great lamp, sending a beam out over the sea.

description.text: Night storm over a rocky headland. A stone lighthouse rises against a black sky, its lantern room dark, while white waves break at the base of the rocks and rain streaks sideways through the air. Far out over the water, sheet lightning flares and briefly silhouettes the tower and the wet stone of the headland. The flare fades, the sea keeps heaving, and the unlit lantern room remains a dark shape at the top of the tower.
A deep, continuous roar of wind and surf fills the scene.
Sheet lightning flares far out over the sea, briefly silhouetting the lighthouse and the breaking waves.
Distant thunder rolls over the water as the rain keeps lashing the stone.
The camera holds a static shot.

Inside the tower, a weathered lighthouse keeper in a heavy oilskin coat climbs a curving iron staircase. One hand grips the cold rail while the other carries a lit hand lantern that throws swinging light across damp stone walls. He leans into each step, coat heavy with rain, as wind moans against the tower and the lantern light sweeps around the curve with him.
Boots ring on the iron steps, and wind buffets the tower walls.
The keeper rounds the curve of the staircase, the hand lantern swinging light across the damp stone.
The lantern handle creaks and his breathing grows heavy.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

The keeper pauses on the last flight of stairs, chest heaving, rain and salt water running off his beard. He grips the iron rail, looks up toward the hatch of the lantern room, and pushes himself on with his jaw set. His exhaustion turns to resolve as the wind rises in the stairwell and water drips onto the iron steps.
Ragged breathing and the moan of wind fill the stairwell.
He lifts his chin toward the lantern-room hatch and starts moving again.
Water drips onto iron, and the wind rises.
The camera holds a static shot.

In the glass lantern room, the keeper sets his hand lantern down and turns the brass valve of the great lamp. The lamp ignites with a bloom of white light, and he steps back as the rotating lens sends a broad beam out through the rain. The beam sweeps across the black water while wind and rain press against the glass and the brass mechanism turns with a low roar.
Wind and rain press against the glass of the lantern room.
The keeper sets the hand lantern down and turns the brass valve.
The great lamp catches with a low roar as the brass mechanism begins to turn.
A broad beam of white light sweeps out through the rain and across the black water.
The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed.
